title: PATCHBAY
description: A developer portfolio that re-routes itself. Plug into Web, Full-stack, AI, or UX/UI to re-compose the page around that discipline.

sections.title: Fixed Header
sections.summary: Brand lockup with SVG jack mark, desktop navigation with animated sliding pill indicator, role switcher chips, and mobile drawer with circular clip-path reveal. Blurs and compresses on scroll down.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: Mask-revealed headline with height reservation to prevent layout shift during role switches, magnetic CTA buttons, the interactive Patch Bay, live count-up metrics, and an availability marquee.

sections.title: Selected Work
sections.summary: Responsive grid of project cards with 3D cursor tilt (±5°), radial spotlight illumination, media scaling, sibling card dimming, technology tags, and animated relevance fit meters.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Signal Flow (Stack)
sections.summary: Three-stage pipeline (Signal In, Patched Through, Signal Out) connected by horizontal signal wires with travelling pulse particles.

sections.title: Process
sections.summary: Four-stage execution roadmap with numbered badges and expanding amber rules.

sections.title: Case Study
sections.summary: Split technical deep dive displaying project visual, problem statement, architectural approach, and key result counters.

sections.title: About & Timeline
sections.summary: Career trajectory and philosophy with year markers and verified external links.

sections.title: Contact Brief Generator
sections.summary: Accessible form with floating labels and client-side validation. On submission, generates a formatted local brief file with a deterministic hashed ticket reference (`PB-XXXXXX`) for the visitor to download. No mock backend network calls.

customCodeBlocks.title: PATCHBAY Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: PATCHBAY Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads lenis in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
